heading.title: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort

article.title: Two years.
article.content:
Against one who, having a right to use property for specific purposes, perverts it to other purposes.
Period of limitationTwo years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the perversion first becomes known to the person injured thereby.
